verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦ : ਦੂਜ ਦੇ ਚੰਦ ਤੋਂ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼
verses.translit_en: pauRee 20 : dhooj dhe cha(n)dh to(n) upadhesh

en.bdb: Lesson from moon of the second phase

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਦਿਹਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਅਲੋਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਤੀਐ ਦਿਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਕਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhui dheh cha(n)dh alop hoi teeaai dheh chaRhadhaa hoi nikaa|

en.bdb: Remaining invisible for two days, third day the moon is beholden in a small  size.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਜੁਹਾਰਦਾ ਗਗਨ ਮਹੇਸੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਟਿਕਾ।
verses.translit_en: auTh uTh jagat juhaaradhaa gagan mahesur masatak Tikaa|

en.bdb: Supposed to adorn the forehead of Mahesa, people bow to it again  and again.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਲਹ ਕਲਾ ਸੰਘਾਰੀਐ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਇਕਾ।
verses.translit_en: soleh kalaa sa(n)ghaareeaai safal janam sohai kal ikaa|

en.bdb: When it has attained all the sixteen phases i.e. on the full moon night, it begins diminishing and again reaches the position of the first day. People now bow before it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਸਿੰਜੈ ਸਹਸਿਕਾ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)mirat kiran suhaavanee nijhar jharai si(n)jai sahasikaa|

en.bdb: Nectar is sprinkled by its rays and it irrigates  all thirsty trees and fields.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਰਤਨ ਅਮਿਕਾ।
verses.translit_en: seetal saa(n)t sa(n)tokh dhe sahaj sa(n)jogee ratan amikaa|

en.bdb: Peace, contentment and cool, these invaluable  jewels are bestowed by it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਅਨੇਰਹੁ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਡੋਰ ਚਕੋਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਛਿਕਾ।
verses.translit_en: karai anerahu chaananaa ddor chakor dhiaan dhar chhikaa|

en.bdb: In darkness, it spreads light and provides the  thread of meditation to the chakor, the redlegged partridge.
Only by erasing  its ego it becomes an invaluable jewel.
